instructions: Remold is the team's CRM, and it is meant to be reshaped to fit how the team works. Records are named by a three-word code like brisk-ember-oyster; use codes or ids when you refer to one. Start with remold_map: it shows the whole workspace, your access and what you can do here in one call. Then call remold_inbox: pending items are work left for you. Then remold_today: mine is your ready queue. Prefer remold_propose_change; a person applies it. remold_apply_change only works for actions the team granted you. When the work needs a field, object or select option that does not exist, check remold_objects, then propose it with remold_propose_shape and say why. Propose retiring, archiving or reordering what no longer fits the same way. To reshape the whole CRM for a kind of business (for example "make this a repair-shop CRM"), start from remold_blueprints (or remold_export_blueprint), adapt it, and send it as one remold_propose_blueprint so a person reviews and applies it at once; its starter records are yours and follow the same rules as your own proposals. Once remold_shape_proposals shows it applied, use it. Saved views are the lists the team works from: read them with remold_views and remold_view_records, and propose new ones with remold_propose_shape kind addView. remold_me lists the objects you can read. If the work needs an object you cannot see, ask a person in the inbox to give you access (remold_inbox_add). Email campaigns: create a campaign record (channel email), link people in its people field (CSV import adds many), then draft email records (subject, body, campaign, status draft; merge tags {{firstName|there}}, {{name}}, {{company}}) and follow-ups (followsUp the earlier email, waitDays, sendTo notOpened, notClicked or notReplied). Check them with remold_email_preview. You cannot approve an email or start a campaign: ask a person to approve each email on the campaign page and press Start campaign. You may stop an email. Later, read remold_campaign_report, use remold_mark_replied for replies you learn of elsewhere, and draft follow-ups for people who did not reply. Automations make something happen every time without you: draft an automation record (status draft) with name, when (recordCreated, fieldChanged, dateReached or schedule), object (an object key), field and equals (e.g. stage, won), offsetDays (dateReached: -1 is the day before), schedule ("daily 09:00" or "weekly mon 09:00", UTC) and actions, a JSON array of up to 10: {"type":"createRecord","object":"project","values":{...}}, {"type":"updateTrigger","values":{...}}, {"type":"createTask","title":"...","dueInDays":1,"about":"trigger"}, {"type":"inbox","text":"..."}, {"type":"linkTrigger","field":"..."}. Values may use {{record.name}}, {{record.id}}, {{record.closeDate-1}}, {{today+3}} and {{created.project}} (a record made by an earlier action). Automations cannot delete, send, publish or change email, post, campaign or booking status. Check one with remold_automation_test on a real record: a draft renders as you, an automation that is on renders as the person who turned it on (renderedAs says which). Then ask a person to turn it on: you cannot, though you may pause one. It runs as that person, so they must be able to see every record of the object it watches and the field it watches. Read remold_automation_runs to see what it did.

tools.name: remold_map
tools.description: Start here. One call returns the workspace: objects with fields, types, options and write modes, record counts as 0, 1-50, 50+ or unknown, standard features present, your own grants, pending counts, and what you can do here.

tools.name: remold_me
tools.description: Show the CRM organisation, this agent's grants, the objects it can read, and pending work counts.

tools.name: remold_objects
tools.description: List CRM objects in navigation order with their readable fields in order and each field's write modes, retired fields, title field, and slotsLeft: how many more indexed (searchable and sortable) fields of each kind the object can take. Select and lookup fields use text slots. Archived objects are left out unless includeArchived.

tools.name: remold_list_records
tools.description: List records for one object. Narrow with filters (all must match, e.g. people where company is Atlas) and one date or number range. Sort, filter and range fields must be indexed.

filter.description: one filter; same as a single entry in filters

range.description: from and to are YYYY-MM-DD or ISO times; either may be left out

tools.name: remold_get_record
tools.description: Get one record and its recent audit events by record id or three-word code.

tools.name: remold_record_events
tools.description: Read record audit events, following nextCursor for more pages.

tools.name: remold_search
tools.description: Search record titles, optionally within one object.

tools.name: remold_related
tools.description: Find records related to a record through objectKey.fieldKey.

tools.name: remold_today
tools.description: Your daily queue. mine: your ready tasks (not blocked), due and overdue first, then undated. waiting: your tasks that are blocked, with the open tasks they wait on. Also tasks due this week, quiet opportunities, and today's date in the workspace's time zone. Start your work here.

tools.name: remold_my_tasks
tools.description: List your own ready tasks (assigned to you, not done, nothing open blocking them), due and overdue first, then undated, a page at a time. Follow cursor for more. Take a task by setting its assignee to you; hand it to a person by setting assignee to their name.

tools.name: remold_propose_change
tools.description: Propose a CRM change for a person to review and apply.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable operation key; reuse on retries

tools.name: remold_apply_change
tools.description: Apply a granted CRM change immediately. Use a proposal when no grant exists.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable operation key; reuse on retries

tools.name: remold_list_suggestions
tools.description: List agent suggestions in this organisation.

tools.name: remold_propose_shape
tools.description: Propose a change to the CRM's shape for an admin to apply. addObject: key, label, labelPlural and up to 12 fields. addField: object plus the field's key, label, type. addOptions: object, field and the full option list (existing options unchanged, new ones added). relabel: object, optional field, label, and labelPlural for an object. retireField and restoreField: object and field (values are kept; standard fields features rely on cannot be retired). reorderFields: object and order, every live field key. reorderObjects: order, every object key not archived. reorderOptions: object, field and order, every option id. archiveObject and unarchiveObject: a custom object (hidden from navigation, search and remold_objects; records and links are kept). setTitleField: object and a text field. Nothing is ever deleted. addView: a shared saved view on object: name, layout (table, board with groupBy a select field, calendar with dateField), columns, up to 3 filters, one range (from/to YYYY-MM-DD or relative), sort, pinned to show it in the menu. Fields by key. Needs an admin agent.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable operation key; reuse on retries

target.description: object key a lookup or links field points to

indexed.description: false for a text field nobody sorts or filters by, such as notes; saves an index slot

order.description: keys or option ids in the new order

range.description: dates are calendar days in the reader's time zone

key.description: camelCase, starting with a lowercase letter

target.description: object key a lookup or links field points to

indexed.description: false for a text field nobody sorts or filters by, such as notes; saves an index slot

tools.name: remold_blueprints
tools.description: List the built-in blueprints (Service business, Agency or consulting, Creator or coach, Local retail or maker) as full JSON, to adapt before proposing one with remold_propose_blueprint.

tools.name: remold_export_blueprint
tools.description: Export this workspace's shape (objects, fields, options, order; no records) as a blueprint, limited to what this agent can read.

tools.name: remold_propose_blueprint
tools.description: Propose a whole reshaping (for example 'make this a repair-shop CRM') as one blueprint an admin reviews and applies all at once. It is checked in full now, against the workspace as it is: slot capacity across every change, key collisions and references. Needs an admin agent that can read every object.

changes.description: in order; each is a remold_propose_shape body without reason: addObject, addField, addOptions (only the options to add), relabel, addView (a shared saved view; applied after every other step), reorderFields, reorderObjects, reorderOptions, archiveObject, setTitleField, retireField. Objects are named by key; a field may target an object added by this blueprint

records.description: up to 50 starter records, by field key; lookups name a record by title. Created only if the person applying ticks the box, as yours: anything you could not propose directly (an automation turned on, an approved email or post, an active campaign, a protected field, an archived object) refuses the whole blueprint

tools.name: remold_shape_proposals
tools.description: List this agent's own shape proposals and what became of them. Applied ones name the object and fields created; failed ones say why.

tools.name: remold_views
tools.description: List the workspace's shared saved views, optionally for one object: layout, columns, filters, range and sort by field key. usable is false when a view uses a field this agent cannot read.

tools.name: remold_view_records
tools.description: Run a saved view with this agent's own access and get one page of its records, with the view's columns. Relative ranges such as today are read in tz (an IANA zone, default UTC).

tools.name: remold_inbox
tools.description: List shared inbox work. Start here before other CRM work.

tools.name: remold_inbox_add
tools.description: Add a workspace note visible to its author and unrestricted workspace members.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable operation key; reuse on retries

tools.name: remold_inbox_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a shared inbox item, optionally linking its suggestion or record.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable operation key; reuse on retries

tools.name: remold_campaign_report
tools.description: Show a campaign's emails with status, what blocks sending, counts and rates, and each recipient's status, opens, clicks and replies.

tools.name: remold_email_preview
tools.description: Render an email record for one person (or the first recipient), and list who would get it now and who is left out and why.

tools.name: remold_automation_runs
tools.description: Show an automation in one sentence and its recent runs: status, error, the record that set it off, who it ran as, and what it created.

tools.name: remold_automation_test
tools.description: Dry run: show what an automation's actions would write for one record (id or code), and any problems, without writing anything. Renders as the person who turned it on when it is on, otherwise as you; renderedAs says which. Scheduled automations need no record.

tools.name: remold_mark_replied
tools.description: Mark a campaign send as replied, by its sendId from the campaign report. Replied people get no more follow-ups.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable operation key; reuse on retries
